title: New aircraft carrier heads toward Mideast after reports of issues on long-deployed USS Lincoln
description: The Pacific-based aircraft carrier USS George Washington has begun heading toward the Middle East as reports have emerged of mental health and supply issues aboard the long-deployed USS Abraham Lincoln.

title: Judge drops Nevada case against electors accused of forging certificate in 2020 election
description: The dismissal marks the latest setback in swing states' efforts to prosecute fake electors who tried to keep Trump in the White House after he lost to Joe Biden in 2020.

title: How a baby born via surrogate became the center of an abortion fight
description: The intended parents had asked to end the pregnancy at 20 weeks when the fetus was diagnosed with a life-threatening condition, setting off a painful legal battle.

title: White House says more than 40 nations help China dodge tariffs
description: A new White House report says that China sends billions of dollars worth of goods to the U.S. via third countries in order to skirt Trump's high tariffs.

title: AIPAC didn't always spend on campaigns. Now it faces criticism over money in politics
description: U.S. support for Israel has been a central issue in Democratic primary contests. That's put a spotlight on the pro-Israel lobbying group AIPAC and the strength of its political influence.

title: Democratic socialism's next test is the Midwest
description: A democratic socialist narrowly lost Wisconsin's Democratic gubernatorial primary. But conversations with swing voters suggest voters may be more open to the "socialist" label than expected.

title: Graham Platner to speak at Maine rally in return to public eye
description: The Labor Day event, where he is slated to discuss the role of unions, will follow the scandal-hit former candidate’s withdrawal from the U.S. Senate race in July.

title: In turnabout, Blanche lauds DOJ career staff in first speech as attorney general
description: His remarks come after months of firings and disparagement of the Justice Department workforce by President Trump.

title: U.S. military has lost roughly 25% of its Reaper drones as Iran war depletes arsenal
description: The aircraft, which cost up to $50 million each, have seen heavy use around the Strait of Hormuz — but they are relatively easy targets for Iran and its proxies.

title: Group sues AMA seeking transparency over Medicare billing codes
description: PatientRightsAdvocate.org says it wants to republish the proprietary billing codes that guide billions of dollars in health care payments.

title: How mainstream Democrats pulled off a big upset against a democratic socialist
description: Supporters and detractors agreed that voters appeared to be increasingly worried over whether Hong could beat GOP nominee Tom Tiffany.

title: The American Dream comes down to OnlyFans, dodgeball and reality TV
description: Life, liberty and the pursuit of solvency take a side hustle, as seen on the small screen.

title: What Democrats can learn from Wisconsin’s ‘oatmeal’ win
description: When the dust settles on this contest, it will probably be the man who critics said was too boring to win statewide in Wisconsin, that deserves most of the plaudits.

title: Sizing up the 2028 Democratic presidential contenders
description: There’s a long list, but some are getting more traction than others.

title: Primary voters send mixed signals about what they want from the Democratic Party
description: Primary results this month in Michigan, Minnesota and Wisconsin paint a muddled picture of just how far to the left Democratic voters want their candidates to be come this fall's midterm elections.

title: Democratic political advisor discusses the party's wins this week
description: NPR's Leila Fadel speaks with Democratic political advisor, Faiz Shakir, about the party's political platform after the wins of this week's primaries.

title: These swing voters in Nevada say they are not dismissing socialist candidates
description: In online focus groups, 10 of 12 Biden-to-Trump voters said they wouldn't automatically think negatively of a politician who identifies with socialism.

title: Author discusses the common myths and stereotypes about domestic violence
description: Allegations of domestic violence against Congressman Max Miller, which he denies, have raised persistent stereotypes about abuse. NPR's Michel Martin talks to author Leslie Morgan Steiner.

title: Rep. Ro Khanna shares why he thinks Democrats should nominate a progressive in 2028
description: NPR's Steve Inskeep asks Democratic Rep. Ro Khanna of California why he says Democrats should nominate a progressive for president in 2028 and why he's considering a run.

title: Rep. Max Miller’s ex-wife sues after sensitive image of child was publicly shared
description: The Ohio Republican had released documents through a publicly accessible Dropbox account this month, seeking to fend off allegations of domestic abuse.

title: Ex-Southern Poverty Law Center official indicted over payments to informants
description: Prosecutors say Heidi Beirich was romantically involved with an informant who was receiving payments. Her lawyer called the case an effort to “silence political opponents.”

title: White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt to leave administration
description: She will leave the administration at the end of August, President Donald Trump announced in a post on Truth Social on Wednesday.

title: Wisconsin surprise raises big questions about polls and Democratic voters
description: Surveys had shown Francesca Hong with a significant lead in the Democratic primary for governor. Then she lost. What did the polls get wrong?

title: Minnesota is first state to set all-female matchups for the biggest races
description: Democratic Lt. Gov. Peggy Flanagan and Republican Michele Tafoya are running for Senate, while Sen. Amy Klobuchar (D) and state House Speaker Lisa Demuth are running for governor.

title: Democratic strategist reflects on Wisconsin and Minnesota primaries
description: NPR's Juana Summers speaks with Amanda Litman, co-founder of the PAC Run For Something, about the results from the Aug. 11 Democratic primary elections.

title: With Crowley atop their ticket, Wisconsin Democrats hope for a 2026 sweep
description: The party establishment is breathing a sigh of relief that democratic socialist Francesca Hong, who led the pre-election polls by double-digits, will not be topping their ticket.

title: Takeaways from the primaries in South Carolina, Wisconsin, Minnesota and Connecticut
description: Democrats fought over age and ideology, while Republicans tested the value of President Donald Trump’s endorsement.

title: Trump says Secret Service told him to switch planes because of threat
description: In his first public comments on the operation, the president downplayed the risks to officials and journalists who remained on Air Force One for the flight from Turkey.

title: Are data centers enough to flip a key House race?
description: Democratic and Republican candidates nationwide are running on their opposition to data center projects.

title: Close aides, but no Cabinet officials, joined Trump in airport catering truck
description: The president was accompanied by some of his most loyal aides but no top administration officials as he made the clandestine move to a different plane to leave Turkey last month.

title: Pirro, in rare move, convenes special grand jury in Washington
description: Unlike typical grand juries, those designated as special focus on a single case or related cases and can issue a report following their investigation.
